summary: First iteration end-to-end review. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests passed (auth + cookies, parties CRUD with computed balance, items CRUD with seeded data, sale/purchase bills with bill_no generation S00001/P00001, auto-rokad linkage on payment_received, dashboard summary, party ledger, auth-required on all non-auth endpoints). Frontend: login -> dashboard -> party create -> item visibility (6 seeded) -> rokad entry -> bill creation -> bill view all PASS. All testid selectors match spec.

minor.issue: Computes party balance for ALL parties on every dashboard call via _compute_party_balance which itself loads all bills/rokad per party. O(N^2) - will get slow with many parties/bills. Consider aggregation pipeline or denormalized balance field.

_next_bill_no uses count_documents which is NOT race-safe under concurrent requests; two simultaneous creates of same bill_type could produce duplicate bill_no. Use an atomic counter collection (findOneAndUpdate $inc) or unique index + retry.
No rate limiting / brute force lockout. Auth playbook recommends lockout after 5 failed attempts.
current=Depends(get_current_user) result is unused but evaluated for auth check - fine, just noting param naming could be clearer (_=Depends).

issues: Uses native browser <select> for Party and Item dropdowns - acceptable but inconsistent with shadcn-style controls available; also uses native <input type='date'> (browser default picker) instead of shadcn calendar - acceptable for desktop but not consistent with design system.
Date input default value comes from todayISO() which uses local time; ensure consistent ISO date handling across timezones.

action_items: Consider making bill_no generation race-safe (atomic counter) before production load.
Add brute force lockout per /app/auth_testing.md (5 fails -> temporary lock).
Optimize dashboard balance aggregation if party count grows >100.
Optional: replace native date input with shadcn calendar to align with design system.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 521 lines - acceptable; if more features are added, split into routers (auth, parties, items, bills, rokad, reports).
_compute_party_balance is called inside list_parties for every party (loop) - causes N+1 query pattern. Consider single aggregation or caching.
Bills POST returns doc with _id removed AFTER insert - good. All endpoints correctly exclude _id via projection {'_id':0} - GOOD pattern.
JWT secret hardcoded length in .env - long random string - acceptable.
CORS allow_credentials=True with explicit origin list - correct for cookie auth.
set_auth_cookies uses samesite='none' + secure=True which requires HTTPS (production preview URL is HTTPS - OK).
Frontend api wrapper sends withCredentials + Bearer fallback - dual auth supported correctly.
test_credentials: admin@galla.com / admin123 (loaded from /app/memory/test_credentials.md - matches backend seed)
seed_data_creation: Test created and cleaned up: TEST_ prefixed parties, items, bills, rokad entries via pytest fixtures. All cleaned. Browser-test party 'DirectTest' and any bills also cleaned via curl after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is solid. 20-test pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers auth, all CRUD, computed party balance, sale/purchase bill_no generation, auto-rokad linkage, dashboard. Backend reseeds 6 galla items if items collection empty. DO NOT save/touch files in /app/backend/* during browser UI tests - uvicorn --reload restarts the backend and creates race conditions for in-flight requests. The empty parties dropdown observed once during testing was caused by such a race (pytest file modified while browser test was running); subsequent runs with stable backend pass. Cookie auth uses samesite=none + secure=true so requests over HTTP will not set cookies - always use the HTTPS preview URL.
rca of the issue: No production bugs found. One transient test failure (parties dropdown empty in NayaBill modal) had root cause: backend was hot-reloading because tests/backend_test.py was being edited mid-test, dropping new party POSTs. After backend stabilized and a party was created via curl, full bill creation flow (party select -> item select -> qty/payment -> save -> navigate to /bills/:id -> render BillView S00001) passes end-to-end.
